definitions.explanation: Texts written in classical Chinese, or the Japanese academic discipline of reading and interpreting such texts using special reading marks. A required subject in Japanese high school education.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{漢文|かんぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}った→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: I studied kanbun in high school.

examples.japanese: {漢文|かんぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{読|よ}み{下|くだ}し⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: Reading kanbun in Japanese word order is difficult.
examples.notes: {読|よ}み{下|くだ}し refers to the technique of reading classical Chinese texts in Japanese grammatical order.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{古典|こてん}{文学|ぶんがく}→古典文学：28231_kotenbungaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{深|ふか}く→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦{理解|りかい}する→理解する：06059_rikaisuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{漢文|かんぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: Knowledge of kanbun is essential for a deep understanding of Japanese classical literature.

notes:
USAGE:
{漢文|かんぶん} is a core subject in Japanese high school education alongside ⟦{古文|こぶん}→古文：17172_kobun⟧ (classical Japanese). Students learn to read classical Chinese texts using {返|かえ}り{点|てん} (return marks) and {送|おく}りがな that indicate Japanese word order. Many famous passages from Chinese classics like the Analerta of Confucius and Tang poetry are studied.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {漢文|かんぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧: kanbun class
- {漢文|かんぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{読|よ}み{下|くだ}し: reading kanbun in Japanese order
- {漢文|かんぶん}⟦{訓読|くんどく}→訓読：18554_kundoku⟧: Japanese reading of classical Chinese
- {返|かえ}り{点|てん}: return marks (used in kanbun)
